interaction.trigger: child selects a trash piece; Roshan arrives at the approach point
interaction.intention: Roshan sweeps the skimmer net under the trash, lifts it out and checks that the water is clearer

decision.reason: No approved key shows Roshan gripping the skimmer; the scoop needs a ready grip, a sweep-through contact pose and a lift. Travel reuses the water swim.

phases.name: anticipation
phases.description: Eyes on the trash; both hands tighten on the handle and draw the net back

phases.name: contact
phases.description: The net sweeps under the trash; shoulders, torso and tail lean into the sweep

phases.name: action
phases.description: She lifts the net clear of the water with the trash in it

phases.name: settle
phases.description: She glances at the clearer water and returns to the ready grip (41 native frames at 24 fps end at 1.708 s)
